newsitem.title: USA: Harveys Casino Resorts Q3 net rises.
newsitem.headline: Harveys Casino Resorts Q3 net rises.

text.p: (dollars in thousands, except for per share amounts)
Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended
NOTE: (a) Net revenues include both management fees and Harveys' equity contribution from the Hard Rock Hotel/Casino.
These amounts include a charge in 1995 of $1.2 million for preopening expenses.

(b) Nonrecurring expenses, net of tax, for the third quarter of 1996 amounted to $380,000 for the early retirement of debt attributable to the application of net proceeds from the company's $150-million senior subordinated note offering.

Nonrecurring expenses, net of tax, for the first nine months of 1996 included $2.5 million of preopening expenses for the opening of Harveys Casino/Hotel in Council Bluffs, Iowa, and $522,000 for the early retirement of debt attributable to the application of net proceeds from the company's $150- million senior subordinated note offering.

The first nine months of 1995 included $2.1 million of preopening expenses, net of tax, resulting from the December opening of Harveys Wagon Wheel Hotel/Casino and the March Opening of the Hard Rock Hotel/Casino.
